subject: [PATCH 51/60] mm: restrict explicit migration to N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new function folio_allows_mempolicy() and uses it instead of existing functions to restrict explicit migration to N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY nodes. It also updates the cpuset migration code to evacuate private memory only from nodes the cpuset no longer allows.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series restricts explicit migration to N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY nodes, allowing userspace NUMA operations to act on memory policy nodes. It introduces a new function folio_allows_mempolicy() that checks if the folio's node permits memory policy and uses it instead of existing functions.
